name: Extra Innovation
body:
Sacrificing your growth as an individual, you work tirelessly to improve your automatons instead.

Prerequisites: Deploy Automaton class feature

Benefit: You gain an additional innovation. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this innovation.

Special: You may take the Extra Innovation feat multiple times. Each time, select a new innovation.

The Tinker: Master of Modular Mechanical Mayhem, Copyright 2013 Bradley Arthur Crouch.
